name: MoreTry TianMa X3+ ZCube Edition 3x3 (Enhanced)
description: The Moretry TianMa X3+ ZCube Edition is a premium 3x3 speedcube designed for speedcubers who demand performance and style. This special edition features the same high-end internals of the popular TianMa X3+—including smooth turning, and excellent corner-cutting, —while showcasing a sleek and vibrant design.
